elevator_pitch: DOCCAD implements Two Content Planes Separation to guarantee that documentation is strictly versioned in Git, verified mechanically via hashes, and served statically without runtime AI dependencies.
technical_explanation: In DOCCAD, Two Content Planes Separation establishes architectural boundaries between human-authored canon and AI-generated derived views, ensuring auditability in PRs and complete offline reproducibility. Context is assembled deterministically and proven with cryptographic hashes.

concepts.name: Docs-as-code and Single Source of Truth
concepts.explanation: Version-controlled files in Git represent the primary ground truth. No external database or CMS is permitted in the serving path.

concepts.name: Two-Plane Structural Separation
concepts.explanation: Canonical documentation (/docs) and AI-generated views (/views) run in separate Docusaurus plugin instances, physically isolating human truth from bot drafts.

concepts.name: Mechanical Drift Detection
concepts.explanation: Derived pages record sha256 digests of their input sources. When source bytes change, CI detects drift and schedules targeted regeneration.

design_decisions.decision: Adopt Two Content Planes Separation as an architectural invariant
design_decisions.rationale: Prevents split-brain state, eliminates unverified hallucinations, and ensures predictable static builds.

tradeoffs.benefit: Auditable evidence assembly with zero index infrastructure and 100% reproducible PR diffs.
tradeoffs.cost: Retrieval depends on frontmatter discipline and will need escalation if the corpus exceeds ~1,500 documents.

tradeoffs.benefit: The site builds and serves with all AI providers down; hosting is trivial and secure.
tradeoffs.cost: No runtime personalization or on-demand chat — new views require a CI generation job.

likely_questions: What is the rationale behind Two Content Planes Separation?
How does the system prevent unreviewed AI content from entering production?
Why is retrieval deterministic instead of embedding-based?

example_answers.question: What is the rationale behind Two Content Planes Separation?
example_answers.answer: Two Content Planes Separation ensures that human engineering knowledge remains the authoritative ground truth, while derived views are generated strictly via explicit task contracts and reviewed via pull requests.

example_answers.question: How does the system prevent unreviewed AI content from entering production?
example_answers.answer: Generated views are committed to isolated docs-gen/* branches and require human peer review approval before merging into the main branch. Auto-merge is strictly disabled.
